answer: Comet-Trail Entropy Binding. Each identity must submit a sensing log whose wildcard fields (timing jitter, sensor plume drift, harbor coordinates) are hashed into its credential. The registry re-derives that hash on every action; duplicated agents sharing one physical source produce correlated wildcards, so the derived values collide and flag the pair. Cloning a distinct agent then costs a full independent sensing rig per identity, not a copied key.
